author: kokonutd
name: faq-with-categories
description:
A comprehensive FAQ section component that features categorized questions using shadcn/ui primitives, including accordion items with category badges.

Features

- Header Section
  - Large title with custom styling
  - Optional description text
  - Centered layout

- FAQ Items
  - Category badges for each item
  - Accordion-style expansion
  - Smooth transitions
  - Custom hover states
  - Card-like appearance
  - Shadow effects

- Categories
  - Visual category indicators
  - Color-coded badges
  - Optional category display
  - Semantic grouping
